title: Laptop Burnout at 4 AM, Healed by Dawn
caption:
POV: it's 4 AM and even your laptop is burning out
A red error pop-up, one drop for tired eyes, a dark 'Burnout' beat, then dawn light refreshes the screen into a sunny sky.
Best watched at night: let the cold blue fade into warm gold and breathe out.
Has a 4 AM session ever left you feeling exactly like this laptop?
Save this for your next late night and share it with a friend who needs rest.
#aesthetic #aianimation #burnoutrecovery #aireels #fruit_drama_tv
